name: inrush current of a saturable transformer
description: A 1 MVA, 10 kV / 1 kV single-phase transformer with an open secondary is switched onto its rated voltage at a voltage zero. The flux linkage rises towards twice its rated peak, the core saturates above 1.2 pu (air-core reactance 0.4 pu) and the first current peak is 1.85 pu of the rated peak current (261 A); the source resistance of 0.5 ohm lets the peaks decay slowly.
